title: IAL InLab
line: An innovation platform made more reliable.
problem: IAL InLab is a platform that supports innovation initiatives within the Institute for Adult Learning (IAL). Some parts of the platform would break whenever certain content fields were left empty in the CMS.
did: As a Frontend Developer, I worked closely with the project managers to identify and fix functional bugs across the platform. One key improvement I implemented was using the nullish coalescing operator (??) to provide safe fallback values for content fields, so the UI handles empty values from StoryBlok CMS without breaking.
outcome: A more reliable platform for both visitors and the content team.
